correctness.rationale: The stated probabilistic path model gives exact geometric-sum objective and adjacent difference. A positive sum of opposite-direction exponentials makes the adjacent-sign factor strictly convex. At the uniform window around departure rates log(n)/n the sign at J is negative, early scores dominate the terminal at the lower window endpoint, and the terminal score dominates every earlier one at the upper endpoint; continuity forces a nonlocal global tie. The \(n=10\) coexistence witness has independent rational endpoint signs and derivative-gap bounds. The code checks finite cases only, and full infinite quantifiers follow from explicit inequalities.

value.rationale: The result resolves a specific mechanistically motivated antagonism: accumulating foreign pollen at early flowers versus maximizing export of local pollen on exit. It proves a nonlocal global position switch of order n despite smooth variation in visitation continuation, supplies a logarithmic candidate reduction and an exact ten-flower witness. It is a meaningful structural boundary for future flower-arrangement models, not a relabeling of a standard rearrangement fact or an isolated table calculation.
